order: Carry the in-progress rename of the plan roundabout from its old name to `deep-plan` out of the working tree into this commit, complete and self-consistent across the harness. Rename the roundabout hook file and convert everything it carries: header and usage text, its environment-variable names, the engine header line, the UNAVAILABLE verdict token, the saved-response temp-directory prefix, and every prose mention. Rename the skill directory and update its frontmatter name and description, headings, runner path, verdict token, and log heading. Point `install.js` at the new runner filename in the runner constant, the install-time copy, and the uninstall list. Update the planner agent file, `ORCHESTRA.md`, and `README.md` end to end. Update the bundled-skill roster in `skills/orchestra-status/SKILL.md` so the status report names `deep-plan`. Nothing else changes here beyond this rename plus its documentation sync, kept as its own commit so it can be split out later.
claims: The rename landed across the harness: the roundabout hook file and its identifiers, the skill directory with its frontmatter, headings, runner path and verdict token, the installer's runner constant, copy step and uninstall list, the planner agent file, `ORCHESTRA.md`, and `README.md` end to end. The bundled-skill roster in `skills/orchestra-status/SKILL.md` now names `deep-plan`. For verification, a case-insensitive repository-wide grep for the old name returns 0 matches, and an installer run into a scratch project reports the four bundled skills with `/deep-plan` among them.
